      "keystrokes": "python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
f=open('/app/doomgeneric_mips','rb')
h=f.read(52)
fields=struct.unpack('<HHIIIIIHHHHHH', h[16:52])
e_phoff,e_phentsize,e_phnum=fields[4],fields[8],fields[9]
e_shoff,e_shentsize,e_shnum,e_shstrndx=fields[5],fields[10],fields[11],fields[12]
print('entry',hex(fields[3]),'phoff',e_phoff,'phnum',e_phnum,'shoff',e_shoff,'shnum',e_shnum)
print('PROGRAM HEADERS')
f.seek(e_phoff)
for i in range(e_phnum):
    ph=struct.unpack('<IIIIIIII', f.read(e_phentsize))
    print(i,'type',ph[0],'off',hex(ph[1]),'vaddr',hex(ph[2]),'filesz',hex(ph[4]),'memsz',hex(ph[5]),'flags',ph[6],'align',hex(ph[7]))
print('SECTION HEADERS')
f.seek(e_shoff)
shs=[struct.unpack('<IIIIIIIIII', f.read(e_shentsize)) for i in range(e_shnum)]
f.seek(e_shoff+e_shstrndx*e_shentsize)
strtab_off=struct.unpack('<IIIIIIIIII', f.read(e_shentsize))[4]
for i,sh in enumerate(shs):
    f.seek(strtab_off+sh[0])
    name=b''
    while True:
        c=f.read(1)
        if not c or c==b'\x00': break
        name+=c
    print(i, name.decode(), 'type',sh[1],'addr',hex(sh[3]),'off',hex(sh[4]),'size',hex(sh[5]),'flags',sh[2])
